comment: Citrus versions the Citrus lab runs against (tests/citrus-lab, docs/core-patches.md). release: a published build, verified against the pinned sha256 and the release's checksums.txt; commit is the tag's commit, whose test/interop suite stage 1 runs. dev: a pinned commit of the dev branch, built from source. Bump: change the values; the sha256 is the line for the asset in checksums.txt of the release.
